prompt:
Create a transparent-background pixel-art atlas with exactly two isolated cells in this order: RIGHT, LEFT, showing the short end-on profile of the same Iron Stations horizontal platform edge segment. Match the Pocket Dungeon source's gray concrete, bright yellow tactile tiles, dark steel and brown timber. The attached source-plus-six sheet provides its identity and the accepted TOP plan; its newly accepted FRONT and REAR profiles are the approved physical slab thickness reference. Use those FRONT/REAR views to match the vertical Z thickness exactly, about 70 px after the target scale. Use the TOP plan to match the full Y/depth span, about 134 px after target scale.

Strict right and left orthographic end elevations, cameras along +X and -X, no perspective or isometric view. Each profile must be a horizontal broad low rectangle roughly 134 px wide by 70 px high: one concrete end block/cap across the full Y width, a thin dark steel rail edge directly below, then shallow dark support with a small brown timber block. The gray top surface is only a thin cap/edge in this elevation. The yellow tactile strip and its raised dots live on TOP and must not appear as a vertical yellow panel. Do NOT make a tall post, stacked vertical column, narrow upright bumper, or an object whose height is equal to or greater than its width. Both views share the same Z height as FRONT/REAR and the full TOP Y depth; maintain exact source identity. Center each whole view in its cell with transparent margins, no labels, no shadows, no cell bleed.
